fields.why: The Table reports aORs for six county urbanization levels and four race/ethnicity groups, each against a stated referent; both look groupwise.
Race/ethnicity (4 groups, white referent) and NCHS urban-rural class (6 levels, large central metro referent) are the SPDs with 3+ groups compared; education and marital status are dichotomous.
No omnibus or trend test is reported; each level is assessed only by its aOR (95% CI) against the referent, so per-group vs referent only with resolves_to_finer true.

brief_issues: The mechanical flag (quote not found) hits table-label quotes in the brief's 'Group › level: value' form (e.g. 'Classification of residence county* › Large central metro: referent'), which rule 6 allows; the checker should accept that form.
